# Fallout 76 - Patch notes – April 12, 2022 / Patch 35

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_109_nukaknights-post-patchnotes35.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Our latest Fallout 76 update delivers a whole host of fresh bug fixes. Read on to find out where things are happening.

### UPDATE VERSION 1.6.4.31

Here you can find out the download size of today's patch on the respective platform:

**PC (Bethesda.net):** 1.6GB
**PC (Microsoft Store):** 9.1GB
**PC (Steam):** 2.2GB
**PlayStation:** 9.2GB
**Xbox:** 9.1GB

### BUG FIXES

##### GRAPHICS

**Weapons:** The Silver Shroud paint job for the Tesla Rifle is now correctly applied to the Charge Shotgun Barrel mod.
##### C.A.M.P.S AND WORKSHOP

**Exploit:** Fixed a bug that allowed cheaters to place NPCs in the game world.
**Lights:** A sound effect will now correctly play when the Diner Wall Light is turned on and off.
**Structures:** Cables can now be attached to the power panel on the fire tower.
**Structures:** The Red Hillbilly Bungalow now has a matching door, which can be found in the “Doors” tab in the Build menu.
**Structures:** Players can now correctly place blueprints using the Charleston Fire Station.
**Walls:** Wall decorations such as pennants, frames, posters, signs, etc. no longer protrude into Enclave C.A.M.P. walls.
##### CHALLENGES

**World:** The requirements for the World Challenge “Complete Various Daily Quests” have been reduced from 23 to 22, and it can now be completed correctly.
##### FIGHT

**V.A.T.S.:** Melee attacks in V.A.T.S. in third-party perspective no longer causes the player to see a black screen.
##### ENEMY

**General:** Fixed issues in instances where enemies would sometimes freeze and become unresponsive.
**Wolves:** Fixed a bug that prevented wolves and other dog-like enemies from attacking the player.
##### QUESTS AND EVENTS

**Public Events:** Using the World Activity Tracker to fast travel to a public event that the player is already participating in will no longer result in the player being removed from that event.
**Public Events:** Players now correctly join a public event when they enter the event location.
**Danger of Collapse:** After completing “Danger of Collapse”, the quest tracker will no longer remain on the screen.
##### FALLOUT WORLDS

**Relaxed Build Restrictions:** Setting the Snap setting to Collision now correctly allows C.A.M.P. objects to be placed without causing Overlapping Objects errors.
##### ITEMS

**Armor:** Fixed a bug that caused Thorn Armor's bleed effect to stack unintentionally. To reflect this change, the Bleed effect now deals five times as much damage as before.
**Exploit:** Fixed an exploit that caused a weapon to deal more damage than intended under certain circumstances.
**Exploit:** Fixed an exploit that allowed players to repeatedly obtain certain magazines in the same location.
**Headgear:** The Captain Cosmos Helmet now correctly prevents damage and illness from aerial threats.
**Melee Weapons:** V.A.T.S. attacks using automatic melee weapons such as the Chainblade will now correctly fill the critical hit bar.
**Ranged Weapons:** Rocket Launchers now correctly damage when used and are no longer indestructible.
**Ranged Weapons:** Alien Blaster and Alien Disintegrator projectiles now correctly impact objects and terrain.
##### LOCALIZATION

**Animations:** Fixed an issue that caused water q when playing Fallout 76 in a language other than English
